title: A great app but 1 complain
body: I’ve used this app a ton and it was helped me to take a walk 5/7 days a week. I love the concept of building something in the app while you are building a habbit in life. And i found it very satisfying when the pieces came down and fit perfectly into their place but lets get to the complaint. After you build everything then you get just the numbers that show you how much many days you have done your habit but i don’t like how the number just changes without you even seeing it when you fill the check mark. It would be a lot more satisfying if you could see the number change and make like a little effect.
author: Michal Hrnko
